payload.title: File:Teeth of Cardabiodon venator from the Fairport Member of the Carlile Shale in Mobsy, Montana.png
payload.description_html: Fig. 3. Cardabiodon venator sp. nov., Collignoniceras woollgari regulare Zone, Fairport Member of the Carlile Shale, Petroleum and Garfield Counties, Mosby, Montana. A. WAM 04.10.64, holotype, second left lower anterior tooth; labial (A1, stereo pair), profile (A2), and lingual (A3, stereo pair) views. B. WAM 04.10.65, paratype, incomplete lower right lateroposterior tooth; lingual (B1, stereo pair) and labial (B2, stereo pair) views. C. WAM 04.10.66, paratype, upper right lateroposterior tooth; labial (C1, stereo pair) and lingual (C2, stereo pair) views. D. WAM 04.10.67, paratype, incomplete upper left lateroposterior tooth; lingual (D1), labial (D2), and profile (D3) views. E. WAM 04.10.68, paratype, incomplete lower left lateroposterior tooth; labial (E1, stereo pair) and lingual (E2) views. F. WAM 04.10.69, paratype, lower left lateroposterior tooth from a yearling?; labial (F1) and lingual (F2) views. G. WAM 04.10.70, paratype, upper? left lateroposterior tooth from a small juvenile; lingual (G1) and labial (G2) views. H. WAM 04.10.71, paratype, incomplete upper left lateroposterior tooth from a very young individual; labial (H1) and lingual (H2) views. All in the same scale.
